name: MakerBot Sketch 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] T0; Set Platform Temp
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] T0; Set Extruder Temp
G90; Use Absolute Positioning
G28; Home
M132 X Y Z A B; Set Current Position to Home
G161 X Y F3300; Move to min axes positions
M7 T0; Wait For Platform to Heat
M6 T0; Wait For Extruders to Heat
M651; Turn on back fan
M907 X100 Y100 Z40 A80 B20; Set Stepper Currents
M106; Enable Cooling Fan
; Purge Line
G92 E0; Reset Extruder Axis Position
G1 X-26.18 Y-75.90 Z0.200 F420
G1 X26.18 Y-75.90 E10
G92 E0; Reset Extruder Axis Position
; Start GCode
machine_end_gcode:
M107; Disable Fan
; End of print
M104 S0 T0; Set Toolhead Temp to 0
M140 S0 T0; Set Platform Temp to 0
G162 Z F1800; Move to max axes position
G28 X Y; Home
M652; Turn off back fan
M132 X Y Z A B; Set Home Position
G91; Use Relative Positioning
M18; Disable Axes
